description: Grays Leasing Limited was incorporated in Pakistan in August 1995 as a public limited company and commenced operations in February 1997, and its shares are listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its stated objective is to carry on the business of leasing and lease operations of all kinds and to provide advisory services, and it says its strength lies in a diversified client portfolio and a wide range of financial products.
